source.map: City of Portland plan districts East Corridor (33.521), Glendoveer (33.530), Hollywood (33.536), Kenton (33.538), Lombard (33.545), Macadam (33.550), North Interstate (33.561), Northwest Hills (33.563) and West Portland Multicultural (33.595), their subdistricts and mapped streets and lines as Portland Maps publishes them
source.says: Each traced lot is one a plan district rule reaches that the screen does not measure: where parking and driveways may go against a named street or light rail line, a required building line, a minimum floor area ratio printed only on a map (East Corridor Map 521-3, Kenton Map 538-3) or above what the pod can supply, a mapped prohibition of residential use, a rear setback set as a share of site depth, a setback set by wall-plane area, the Linnton Hillside lot-of-record rule, or the Glendoveer flag-lot standards (15 ft from every lot line, 25 ft height, 33.530.050), which the screen cannot apply because no lot is read as a flag lot

inputs.taxlots: flats.lots geometry of run 113 (the quadfit lot shapes the screen reads, Metro RLIS taxlots)
inputs.subdistricts: plan-subdistricts.geojson (layer 1): HW SUBDISTRICT A, LB SUBDISTRICT B, WP SUBDISTRICT A/B/C, NH FOREST PARK subarea LINNTON
inputs.streets: transit-streets.geojson (E BURNSIDE ST, N INTERSTATE AVE); https://www.portlandmaps.com/arcgis/rest/services/Public/BPS_Zoning_Code_Layers/MapServer/32 (HW Enhanced Pedestrian Streets, Map 536-3); https://www.portlandmaps.com/arcgis/rest/services/Public/BPS_Zoning_Code_Layers/MapServer/141 (WP commercial corridors and Barbur Transit Center, Map 595-3), fetched 2026-11-03
inputs.building_lines: required-building-lines.geojson and https://www.portlandmaps.com/arcgis/rest/services/Public/BPS_Zoning_Code_Layers/MapServer/71 (NI required building lines, Map 561-4)
inputs.far: https://www.portlandmaps.com/arcgis/rest/services/Public/BPS_Zoning_Code_Layers/MapServer/50 (KN MINFAR "1:1", Map 538-3; EC MINFAR ".5:1" and "1:1", Map 521-3), fetched 2026-11-03
inputs.glendoveer: plan-districts.geojson GL outline; flats.lots facts geometry_tier = 'C' (concave, many-sided or pole-shaped) on run 113

source.method: Lots at least one tenth inside the district, taken whole: EC through lots and lots with two or more street faces within 75 ft of E Burnside; NI lots outside the R zones within 30 ft of a required building line, and lots with two or more street faces within 75 ft of N Interstate; HW every Subdistrict A lot, and lots with two or more street faces within 75 ft of an Enhanced Pedestrian Street; WP every Subdistrict A and B lot, CM2 and CM3 lots within 75 ft of a commercial corridor, and RM1-RM3 lots in Subdistrict C that are not corner lots and are over 100 ft deep or of unknown depth; MA every lot; LB Subdistrict B lots with two or more street faces; GL R7 lots of geometry tier C (34 on run 113, none green), the lots a flag lot can be among. Street faces and corners read from front_bearings_deg. Unioned with the EC Map 521-3 minimum-FAR polygons (.5:1 and 1:1, every lot inside held, because the figures are printed on the map and not in the chapter text), the KN 1:1 minimum-FAR polygons and the NH Linnton Hillside subarea outline, untraced (no lot inside the KN or NH areas was green on run 113). Coordinates to 0.01 ft.
source.traced_by: FOLLOWUPS 109 Portland plan districts part 2 batch A, 2026-11-03
